data.one_liner: Compress images using Luban‑style algorithm for Dart/Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to compress image files with configurable quality, target size, and caching. Works across mobile, web, and desktop platforms using the image and cross_file packages.
use_when: You need fast, loss‑y image compression without native code
You want a pure‑Dart solution that runs on all Flutter platforms
avoid_when: You need advanced editing features beyond compression
strengths: Cache support to avoid repeated work
weaknesses: Limited to lossy compression, no advanced editing
Algorithm may not match native compressors in speed

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level image manipulation and compression without the Luban‑style heuristics
